items.question: How many days of paid annual leave does a full-time employee get?
items.answer: Every full-time employee at Fernhill Analytics receives 25 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, in addition to public holidays. [annual-leave]
items.reference: Full-time employees get 25 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, in addition to public holidays.

items.question: How many unused holiday days can I carry over into the next year?
items.answer: You may carry over a maximum of 5 unused days into the next calendar year. [annual-leave] Every full-time employee at Fernhill Analytics receives 25 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, in addition to public holidays. [annual-leave]
items.reference: You can carry over a maximum of 5 unused days, and they must be used by 31 March.

items.question: By what time do I have to tell my manager that I am off sick?
items.answer: Instead, time off in lieu can be agreed with your manager for work outside normal hours, such as a weekend release. [working-hours] If you are too unwell to work, tell your line manager before 10:00 on the first day of absence. [sick-leave]
items.reference: Tell your line manager before 10:00 on the first day of absence, directly rather than in the team channel.

items.question: For how many days can I self-certify a sickness absence?
items.answer: You can self-certify sickness absence for up to 7 calendar days. [sick-leave]
items.reference: You can self-certify sickness absence for up to 7 calendar days.

items.question: What is the maximum hotel rate per night in London?
items.answer: Hotel rates are capped at 180 GBP per night in London and 130 GBP per night elsewhere in the United Kingdom. [travel] You may carry over a maximum of 5 unused days into the next calendar year. [annual-leave]
items.reference: Hotels in London are capped at 180 GBP per night.

items.question: What meal allowance can I claim per day while travelling?
items.answer: While travelling you may claim a meal allowance of up to 45 GBP per day for food, using the expenses process in Ledgerly. [travel]
items.reference: Up to 45 GBP per day for food, claimed through Ledgerly.

items.question: Within how many days of the purchase must I claim a business expense?
items.answer: Business expenses are claimed in the Ledgerly expenses app within 30 days of the purchase date. [expenses]
items.reference: Claim within 30 days of the purchase date in Ledgerly; claims more than 60 days after purchase are rejected.

items.question: What is the minimum length for a work password?
items.answer: I can't find that in the Fernhill handbook.
items.reference: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long and stored in Keystone.

items.question: How often are laptops refreshed?
items.answer: Laptops are refreshed every 3 years. [equipment-it]
items.reference: Laptops are refreshed every 3 years.

items.question: Up to what value can I accept a gift from a supplier?
items.answer: You may accept gifts or hospitality from suppliers worth up to 50 GBP. [code-of-conduct]
items.reference: You may accept gifts or hospitality worth up to 50 GBP; above that they must be declared.

items.question: How much does Fernhill contribute to my pension?
items.answer: Fernhill contributes 6 percent of base salary to the company pension scheme when you contribute at least 4 percent. [benefits] Medical appointments that cannot be scheduled outside working hours do not count as sickness absence, but you should give your manager as much notice as possible. [sick-leave]
items.reference: Fernhill contributes 6 percent of base salary when you contribute at least 4 percent.

items.question: How long is the probation period for new joiners?
items.answer: New joiners attend a company induction day, held on the first Tuesday of every month, where each department introduces its work. [onboarding] The probation period is 6 months. [onboarding]
items.reference: The probation period is 6 months.

items.question: How big is my personal learning budget each year?
items.answer: Each employee has a personal learning budget of 1,200 GBP per calendar year for courses, conferences, books and certifications. [learning-budget]
items.reference: Each employee has a learning budget of 1,200 GBP per calendar year, which does not roll over.

items.question: What allowance do I get for a week of on-call cover?
items.answer: Employees on the on-call rota receive an allowance of 250 GBP per week of on-call cover, plus time off in lieu for any incident work outside working hours longer than 2 hours. [working-hours]
items.reference: The on-call allowance is 250 GBP per week of cover, plus time off in lieu for long incident work.

items.question: How many days per week am I expected to be in the office?
items.answer: Employees are expected in the office on at least 2 days per week, and every team agrees one shared anchor day when everyone attends. [remote-work]
items.reference: At least 2 days per week, including your team's shared anchor day.

items.question: How many weeks of partner leave at full pay do second parents get?
items.answer: Partners and second parents receive 8 weeks of paternity or partner leave at full pay, which can be taken in up to two blocks within the first 12 months after the birth or adoption. [parental-leave]
items.reference: Partners and second parents get 8 weeks of partner leave at full pay.

items.question: I have worked here for 6 years. How many annual leave days do I get, and how many can I carry over?
items.answer: You also get 5 learning days per year, which are paid working days reserved for study or attending training. [learning-budget] Unused leave beyond the carry-over limit is not paid out, except when you leave the company. [annual-leave]
items.reference: After 5 years of service the allowance is 28 days, and you can carry over at most 5 unused days.

items.question: A conference ticket costs 620 GBP. Does learning budget spending need approval in advance, and who approves an expense claim above 500 GBP?
items.answer: Claims above 500 GBP also need approval from the budget holder in Finance. [expenses] Spending from the learning budget needs manager approval in advance through Harbour. [learning-budget]
items.reference: Learning budget spending needs manager approval in advance through Harbour, and claims above 500 GBP also need approval from the Finance budget holder.

items.question: During probation, what is my notice period, and by when must I finish security awareness training?
items.answer: During probation the notice period on either side is 1 week. [onboarding] In the first week you complete the security awareness training, set up Keystone and multi-factor authentication, and meet your manager to agree 30-60-90 day goals. [onboarding]
items.reference: During probation the notice period is 1 week, and security awareness training must be completed within 14 days of joining.

items.question: If I am rated Below Expectations, am I eligible for a pay increase, and how long does the improvement plan last?
items.answer: If your rating is Below Expectations, your manager agrees a performance improvement plan with you lasting 8 to 12 weeks, with fortnightly check-ins. [performance-reviews] Employees rated Below Expectations are not eligible for a pay increase in that cycle. [performance-reviews]
items.reference: No, Below Expectations means no pay increase that cycle, and the performance improvement plan lasts 8 to 12 weeks.

items.question: When I leave the company, how long do I have to return my laptop, and is unused annual leave paid out?
items.answer: Unused leave beyond the carry-over limit is not paid out, except when you leave the company. [annual-leave]
items.reference: Equipment must be returned within 5 working days of your last day, and unused leave is paid out when you leave the company.

items.question: How much does life assurance pay, and from when am I covered by private medical insurance?
items.answer: Private medical insurance covers you from your first day. [benefits] Life assurance pays four times your base salary. [benefits]
items.reference: Life assurance pays four times base salary, and private medical insurance covers you from your first day.

items.question: If I am off sick for 25 working days this year, how much of that is on full salary, and when do I need a fit note?
items.answer: Every full-time employee at Fernhill Analytics receives 25 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, in addition to public holidays. [annual-leave] After that, company sick pay drops to half salary for a further 20 working days, and then to statutory sick pay only. [sick-leave]
items.reference: Full salary is paid for up to 20 working days in a rolling 12 months, then half salary; a fit note is needed for absences longer than 7 calendar days.
